optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Demand Forecasting Analyst, Small Kitchen Appliances

professionalSummary.text: Produces weekly SKU-level statistical demand forecasts for 1,100+ active products using Python (statsmodels and LightGBM) with Monday refreshes from Halden Housewares' order-history warehouse.
professionalSummary.witness: Built and ran a weekly SKU-level forecast for about 1,100 active products using Python (statsmodels and LightGBM), refreshed every Monday from the order-history warehouse at Halden Housewares.

experienceHighlights.text: Published monthly forecast-accuracy reports with MAPE and bias metrics by product family and retailer, used as S&OP cycle input.
experienceHighlights.witness: Published a monthly forecast-accuracy report giving MAPE and bias by product family and by retailer, used as the accuracy input to the S&OP cycle.

experienceHighlights.text: Incorporated retailer promotion calendars and planned price changes into forecasts through fortnightly meetings with key-account team, maintaining a promotion log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Met the key-account team each fortnight to load retailer promotion calendars and planned price changes into the forecast as event features, keeping a promotion log next to each forecast run.

experienceHighlights.text: Presented consolidated demand views at monthly S&OP meetings, answering plant planners' questions during two meetings when demand planning manager was absent.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the demand slides for the monthly S&OP meeting and answered the plant planners' questions on the forecast at two meetings while the demand planning manager was on leave.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented model changes and validation results in the analytics model register, including feature updates, retraining schedules, and hyper-parameter adjustments.
experienceHighlights.witness: Logged each model change (new features, retraining schedule, hyper-parameter updates) in the analytics model register with the back-test results attached.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Model-register entry for March retraining of blender-category model, including feature changes, 26-week back-test table of MAPE and bias by retailer, and approval date from reviewing analyst.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: a model-register entry for the March retraining of the blender-category model, listing the feature changes, a 26-week back-test table of MAPE and bias by retailer, and the date the reviewing analyst approved the change.

skills.text: Python (statsmodels, LightGBM), forecast accuracy metrics (MAPE, bias), retailer promotion integration, S&OP meeting presentation, model register documentation.
skills.witness: Built and ran a weekly SKU-level forecast for about 1,100 active products using Python (statsmodels and LightGBM), refreshed every Monday from the order-history warehouse at Halden Housewares.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's direct involvement in producing weekly forecasts, measuring accuracy, incorporating promotions, presenting at S&OP meetings, and documenting model changes. The materials do not establish the candidate's ownership of the forecast model (e.g., sole responsibility for model design), deployment environment (e.g., production vs. test), or the candidate's role in approving model changes beyond logging them.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess S&OP presentation skills and model approval authority.
